scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Sometimes I think Victor killed Ethan's father too.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: What happened that made you think it?

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: He died suddenly. Nobody would answer me. Then Victor arrived as if a place had become vacant.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: We will not dismiss the question. We also cannot call it answered.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I know. Being frightened of him does not give me proof.

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
